modelingNotes: S1: ABB 1SCC316001C0201, OFA1GB 02_09, pp. 2-3, 5 and 7. Exact order OFAX 00 S1L: one pole, size 00, In 160 A, Ui 1000 V, IP20, terminal width 20 mm. Ui is insulation capability; no nominal supply voltage is assigned.

S2: ABB 1SBC 0101 00 R1001, printed pp. 7/3 and 7/5 lists 690 V without identifying Ui. Do not conflate that entry with the 1000 V insulation rating or assume a revision-specific operating-voltage reconciliation.

TAB, FUSE, TAP and A/B are authoring aliases, not ABB terminal markings or line/load orientation. A and B denote opposed conductive assemblies. TAB is the bare main connection interface; separately ordered cable-clamp and bolt accessories are excluded.

S1 p. 3, exploded drawing S00288A, shows each main tab, fuse contact and built-in measuring terminal in a local conductive assembly. Explicit project jumpers must implement TAB.A-FUSE.A, TAB.A-TAP.A, TAB.B-FUSE.B and TAB.B-TAP.B. Functions alone create no continuity. No fixed link connects A and B.

The removable fuse is excluded. No fuse characteristic or switching/protection rating is modeled. The built-in measuring terminal is described as 2.5 mm2; the base 160 A rating is not assigned to that tap. No wire size or accessory is selected.

Six endpoint bus functions use terminal circuit symbols. All external connections are application-dependent. No PE, shield or communication endpoint is evidenced; mechanical rail mounting creates no bonding claim.

connectionCoverage.notes: Six functional endpoints: two main tabs, two fuse mating contacts and two built-in measuring taps. Family construction drawings establish the local assemblies; terminal inscriptions and individual conductor-entry positions within measuring clamps are unverified. Names are functional authoring aliases. Separate terminal accessories and removable fuse are excluded.
